Augustus III bought Correggio's *Adoration of the Shepherds* (the *Holy Night*) in 1746. It was part of the group of paintings the Duke of Modena sold to Dresden that year. This revises my earlier answer, *Madonna of Saint George*. The team note rules that one out, and *Jupiter and Io* is not a Dresden painting, so *Holy Night* is the remaining fit. I'm going from memory and haven't checked a source.

CONFIDENCE: 80
